title: private-deployment-orion-weekly-sync-2026-08-03
content:
Weekly sync notes - Orion private deployment (VPC/on-prem)
Date: 2026-08-03
Owner: Aisha Patel (Redwood SE)
Attendees: Aisha, Daniel, Marina, Samir, Jorge (Orion Eng), Priya (Orion PM)

Purpose: quick status check on remaining milestones for Phase 2 (on-prem rollout), unblock items, confirm owners and dates for next 2 sprints.

Agenda
- Quick status round (2m each)
- Network & infra (VPC peering, routing)
- Install automation & image validation
- Security & KMS procurement
- Acceptance testing & perf targets
- Open blockers / action items

Notes / Updates
1) Network & infra
- Orion confirmed VPC peering config (route tables) working in staging. Minor subnet overlap found in 10.2.0.0/16 vs. internal Orchestration - Jorge to resolve.
- Action: Jorge to update peering CIDR plan and push updated diagram to Confluence by 2026-08-06. (owner: Jorge Martinez)
- Risk: until CIDRs resolved, can't proceed with cross-subnet traffic tests.

2) Install automation & images
- Image build pipeline (internal registry) done. We hit a checksum mismatch in one image during canary deploy yesterday; suspected packaging step bug in our builder.
- Action: Daniel to triage build pipeline, re-run image build with debug flags and publish fixed image by 2026-08-05. Attach logs to jira:ORION-1287. (owner: Daniel Kim)
- Temporary workaround: use previous stable image (v1.11.2) for further test runs.

3) Security & KMS
- Orion procurement update: HSM appliance order delayed ~5 business days. In the interim they will provide a cloud KMS key for onboarding test.
- Action: Marina to validate key rotation/permissions with Orion security and confirm test KMS access by 2026-08-04. (owner: Marina Lopez)
- Note: Redwood side needs to ensure KMS integration docs updated for cloud-key fallback - tracked in confluence:ORION-private-deploy-plan-9876.

4) Acceptance testing & perf targets
- Test plan: baseline latency target < 150ms p95 for text generation at 4 concurrent reqs; throughput target 25 req/s for the selected model bundle.
- First acceptance window planned 2026-08-10 -> 2026-08-14 (staging).
- Action: Samir to prepare load test scripts and baseline perf dashboard, run dry-run by 2026-08-08. (owner: Samir Rao)

5) Rollout plan / milestones (summary)
- Phase 1 (completed): initial infra + control-plane setup (completed 2026-07-22)
- Phase 2 (current): image validation, KMS integration, acceptance tests (ETA mid-Aug)
- Phase 3 (next): on-prem pilot with 2 services, canary routing, SLA handoff (ETA end-Aug / early Sep)

Blockers
- CIDR overlap preventing cross-subnet tests (blocking net e2e validation) - owner: Orion (Jorge)
- Image checksum failure during build pipeline - owner: Redwood (Daniel)
- HSM procurement delay - owner: Orion procurement (Priya to escalate)

Decisions needed
- Accept cloud-KMS fallback for onboarding tests? (proposal: yes, with stricter audit logging).
- Use previous stable image for next test window or pause until new image is built? (proposal: use stable image + rebuild in parallel).

Action items (consolidated)
- Jorge Martinez (Orion): update peering CIDR plan + Confluence diagram by 2026-08-06.
- Daniel Kim (Redwood): triage build pipeline, re-publish fixed image, attach logs to jira:ORION-1287 by 2026-08-05.
- Marina Lopez (Redwood): validate test KMS access and permissions by 2026-08-04.
- Samir Rao (Redwood): prepare load test scripts and run dry-run by 2026-08-08.
- Priya Desai (Orion): escalate HSM procurement timeline and confirm fallback plan by 2026-08-05.
- Aisha Patel (Redwood): update rollout timeline slide and send to stakeholders (email + slack) by 2026-08-06.

Follow-ups / next meeting
- Proposed next sync: 2026-08-10 (Mon) 10:00 PT - Align before acceptance window.
- Keep Confluence page updated: confluence:ORION-private-deploy-plan-9876 (Aisha to do a quick cleanup of outstanding todos).

Notes to self (scratchpad)
- Need to check if firewall ACLs on Orion side will block our healthcheck port (tcp/8888) - add to test checklist.
- Consider temporary increased logging during acceptance tests to capture perf edge cases (cost vs. observability tradeoff).
- If HSM delays push beyond mid-Aug, escalate to legal for exception paperwork for cloud-KMS short-term.

End of notes.
